description.narrative: WRC's project is the continuation of the project “Improved alignment of state commitments with Istanbul and CEDAW Convention in Montenegro” (Ref: SE-ON-802401-6134-WB-ME2) under the 2024-2025 programme “The Kvinna till Kvinna Regional Programme - Democracy and Resilience in the Western Balkans: Supporting Feminist Change Agents” (Ref: SE-ON-802401-6134-WB).

Within the Kvinna till Kvinna Foundation's regional program "Democracy and Resilience in the Western Balkans: Supporting Feminist Change Agents 2.0," the partner organisation Women's Right Center (WRC) is receiving core support. This core support will strengthen the organisational capacities of WRC and contribute to both impact areas of the program: challenging anti-democracy movements and narratives across the Western Balkans, and improving alignment across the Western Balkans with the Istanbul Convention within focus countries. This includes WRC's work on the project "Improved alignment of state commitments with Istanbul and CEDAW Convention in Montenegro" to strengthen the GBV survivor-centered approach and women's access to justice. WRC will accomplish this by providing gender-sensitive free legal services, empowering civic activism to hold the Montenegrin government accountable, and contributing to the development of gender-sensitive policies and procedures in Montenegro.
